channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran, US exchange new attacks: Who was hit in latest strikes?
item.description: Iran says the US bombed a wedding near the Strait of Hormuz; hits Kuwait, Bahrain, and Jordan in retaliation.

item.title: Why Greece is betting on Israel’s Achilles Shield
item.description: The defence deal between the two countries fits into a larger shift in regional alliances amid the US-Israel war on Iran.

item.title: ‘We had an ordinary life’: Iran fisherwoman navigates uncertainty of war
item.description: An Iranian fisherwoman explains how her idyllic seaside life was shattered when the US and Israel began their bombing.

item.title: BBC travels inside occupied Lebanon as officials say Israel expanding positions
item.description: A BBC team joined a humanitarian mission of the UN peacekeeping force, which says Israeli troops are fortifying positions and continuing demolitions.

item.title: Bus crash on Egypt's Red Sea coast kills 22
item.description: Reports say Jordanian nationals are among those killed in the accident in the South Sinai governorate.

item.title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
item.description: As of August, the number forced to return this year from Pakistan and Iran had reached another million.

item.title: Deadly strike on Kyiv warehouse prompts evacuations
item.description: Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv after the deadly strike, which authorities said killed more than 30 people.
